name: idc-ldct-and-projection-data
description: Low-dose CT images and projection data from 200 patients, including non-contrast head CT, low-dose chest CT for pulmonary nodule screening, and contrast-enhanced abdominal CT for metastatic liver lesion detection. CT projection data is provided in the open DICOM-CT-PD format alongside reconstructed images, patient age/gender, and pathology annotations. Please see the LDCT-and-Projection-data page to learn more about the images and to obtain any supporting metadata for this collection.

recordSet.name: Clinical variables with measured completeness
recordSet.description: Completeness is measured from the source repository's own records. A field populated entirely with non-answers is reported as populated but not informative, because it blocks an analysis just as surely as an absent field.
